# Coreframe Technologies

> Coreframe is an AI research and engineering company. We design, deploy and operate private AI, enterprise knowledge systems and autonomous workflows for enterprises — on-premise, private cloud, hybrid or edge. We also do general software engineering and digital transformation.

Coreframe Technologies Private Limited. Contact: info@coreframetech.in. Machine-readable company/capability data: https://coreframetech.in/api/agent (JSON).

## Capabilities

- [Private AI & On-Premise LLMs](https://coreframetech.in/capabilities/private-ai): On-premise, private-cloud, hybrid and air-gapped LLM deployment; small language models, local inference, data-sovereignty architecture. For teams whose data can't leave their environment.
- [AI Agents & Autonomous Workflows](https://coreframetech.in/capabilities/ai-agents): Tool-using AI agents, multi-agent systems and agentic workflow automation with human-in-the-loop oversight, MCP integrations and auditability.
- [AI Strategy, Governance & Evaluation](https://coreframetech.in/capabilities/ai-strategy-governance): AI readiness assessments, roadmaps, model evaluation, red-teaming, governance advisory and EU AI Act compliance assessment (risk classification, gap register, conformity documentation, human-in-the-loop protocols).
- [All capabilities](https://coreframetech.in/capabilities): Overview of all seven capability areas, including Enterprise AI & Knowledge Systems, AI Infrastructure & Engineering, Software Engineering & Digital Transformation, and Edge AI & Intelligent Systems (landing pages in progress).
